newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee ends up in kerb, seen steady.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee closed 0.13 rupee up at 42.90 to the dollar on Sunday in the kerb amid greater supply of the U.S. currency, but dealers said the rupee was likely to remain stable at current levels.

They said present levels were attractive and some dollar buying was likely to filter through on Monday keeping the rupee stable. The State (central) Bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed at 7.20 percent, compared to the previous close of 7.30 percent.
